newsitem.title: FRANCE: Investors less rosy on French share market - poll.
newsitem.headline: Investors less rosy on French share market - poll.

text.p: Investors and financial market professionals are less rosy about the outlook for the French shares market, according to an opinion poll before President Jacques Chirac confirmed he was calling an early election.
The SOFRES poll published in daily La Tribune said that 31 percent of those questioned expected a rise on the Paris bourse, that 24 percent were predicting a fall and that 42 percent saw stability.
In January, 58 percent of those interviewed expected a rise.
The CAC-40 leading share index has risen by 32 percent since the start of January.
The poll said that 28 percent were buyers, versus 32 percent in January, while 60 percent advised clients to hold. In January this was 59 percent.
